items.title: Legends Awaken Release Tournament and new Shop Tournament prizes for November
items.summary: Official tournament stores each run one Legends Awaken Release Tournament, November 1 to 30, 2026 (Standard, 5-round Swiss, best of 1, decks have at least 10 Legends Awaken cards; entrants get an ESOUL-017 PR card and a champion playmat of Frostallion, Jetragon and Frostallion Noct); Bushi Navi registration opens October 10 at 8 AM PT, November Shop prizes switch to PR Card Pack Vol.2 (17 cards).

items.title: Palworld OCG sales projected to pass 11 million packs worldwide
items.summary: Bushiroad projects that combined worldwide sales of Booster Pack Dawn of Palpagos and Booster Pack Legends Awaken will surpass 11 million packs by early November 2026, while official demo sessions have passed 24,000 participants and Sleeve & Card Set Vol.1 and Legends Awaken go on sale October 16 and October 30.

items.title: Palworld OCG PR cards for BanG Dream! 13th☆LIVE concert attendees
items.summary: Attendees of Mugendai Mewtype's "DIMENSIONAL OVERLAP" DAY2 show at BanG Dream! 13th☆LIVE (October 11, 2026, Tokyo Garden Theater) each receive one random special Palworld OCG PR card; Palworld OCG also has merchandise and displays at the event (October 10–12).
